brief.title: Fitness Tracker User Health & Activity Analytics Report
brief.one_liner: A comprehensive analysis of daily health metrics, activity patterns, and lifestyle indicators across a synthetic cohort of fitness tracker users from 2015 to 2025.
brief.goal: Enable the health analytics team to identify key activity and wellness patterns segmented by demographics, workout behavior, and lifestyle factors, and to surface actionable insights for product feature development and user engagement strategies.

required_sections.title: User Demographics & Body Metrics Overview
required_sections.objective: Summarize the distribution of users by age, gender, height, and weight, highlighting key demographic segments in the dataset.

required_sections.title: Physical Activity & Workout Patterns
required_sections.objective: Analyze daily step counts, workout types, and workout durations to identify activity level distributions and preferences across user segments.

required_sections.title: Heart Rate, Sleep & Calorie Burn Analysis
required_sections.objective: Examine average heart rate, sleep duration, and calories burned, exploring correlations and distributions across demographic and activity groups.

required_sections.title: Lifestyle & Wellness Indicators
required_sections.objective: Assess water intake, stress levels, and mood distributions, and explore how these lifestyle factors relate to physical activity and health metrics.

required_sections.title: Temporal Trends & Seasonal Patterns
required_sections.objective: Investigate how key health and activity metrics evolve over time (yearly, monthly, or day-of-week), identifying any notable trends or seasonal effects.

required_sections.title: Key Insights & Recommendations
required_sections.objective: Synthesize the most important findings from the analysis and provide data-driven recommendations for product and engagement strategies.

kpis.name: Average Daily Steps
kpis.description: Mean number of steps taken per day across all users, segmented by key dimensions.

kpis.name: Average Calories Burned
kpis.description: Mean daily calorie expenditure, analyzed by workout type and demographic group.

kpis.name: Average Sleep Duration
kpis.description: Mean hours of sleep per night, with attention to variation across stress levels and mood categories.

kpis.name: Workout Participation Rate
kpis.description: Percentage of daily records where a workout was performed (workout_type is not 'None').

kpis.name: Average Stress Level
kpis.description: Mean stress level score across the user base, segmented by activity level and mood.
